run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the mailing group CC'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and appends the Google Mock group to the CC list
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default CC recipients beyond the Google Mock group
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py script which passes CLI args to upload.py with an added CC flag
